title: NPC Schedules — Kingdom Hearts 0: Door to Darkness
note: All NPCs speak through the terminal. Sora, Donald, Goofy are the party; world NPCs anchor each world's scenes; shop/flavor NPCs give traversal flavor.

npcs.name: Sora
npcs.appearance: brown spiky hair, yellow shorts, red shirt, oversized keyblade

greetings.destiny_islands: Hey, Zero! Are you a new friend? I drew a keyblade — look!
greetings.traverse_town: Wow, you're fast! Where'd you learn to swing like that?
greetings.neverland: I can feel it — there's a light here that's mine.
greetings.wnwas: I have to go on alone. But I know you're with me.

lines.text: Sora stares at the stars. 'Do you think my friends are under these same ones?'
Sora stretches. 'Alright! Let's go! I'm ready!'
Sora juggles a red apple. 'Dude, you wanna bite?'
Sora polishes the Kingdom Key. 'I promised Kairi. I promised Riku. I promised myself.'
Sora races a shadow on the wall, laughing.
Sora looks toward the horizon. 'Another keyhole. I can feel it.'
Sora yawns. 'Tomorrow. Tomorrow we close another one.'

general_lines: He doesn't know who he is yet, but he knows what he'll become.
His laughter is the first sound the Heartless ever learned to fear.
Zero watches him and wonders what a keyblade that chose its wielder feels like.

npcs.name: Donald
npcs.appearance: blue feathered sorcerer with a white-nib mage hat, red-nibbed staff

greetules.traverse_town: Oh, it's you! Don't scare me like that!
greetules.hollow_bastion: There's so much magic here — some of it's mine, somehow.

lines.text: Donald is asleep. He snores in three-note melodies.
Donald stretches his wings. 'Aaagh! Why do I always wake up before Goofy?'
Donald practices Firaga on a sandbag. 'Gawrsh, that one felt good!'
Donald checks his spellbook. 'Thundaga takes less MP if you aim small.'
Donald is fuming. 'Where IS that king?!'
Donald offers Zero a potion. 'For emergencies.'
Donald counts his MP. 'I'm running low. Save the rest for the boss.'

general_lines: He was court magician before he was a hero. It shows.
When he's angry, he's the loudest thing in the room. That's useful.
He treats Zero like a new recruit. Zero does not correct him.

npcs.name: Goofy
npcs.appearance: tall knight in blue armor, shield in hand, green hat

greetings.traverse_town: Well howdy! Ain't you a sight for sore eyes!
greetings.olympus: Hercules is my hero — I wanna be strong like him!

lines.text: Goofy is asleep with his shield over him like a blanket.
Goofy stumbles into camp. 'Oh boy, oh boy — what a sunrise!'
Goofy polishes his shield. 'This old thing's saved me more times than I can count!'
Goofy offers Zero a Hi-Potion. 'Ya look a little rough, pal.'
Goofy practices a shield bash. 'Hi-yah! Did that look okay?'
Goofy looks at the darkening sky. 'Don't worry — we got this.'
Goofy yawns. 'Night, Zero. See ya in the mornin'.'

general_lines: He is the least confused person in the party. That is its own kind of power.
His shield has blocked more darkness than he'll admit.
He calls Zero 'pal'. Zero has never been called that before.

npcs.name: Cloud
npcs.appearance: spiky blond hair, dark pants, violet eyes, massive buster sword

greetings.olympus_coliseum: You're not from around here. But you swing like you know what it costs.
greetings.hollow_bastion: The darkness in that castle — it knows my name. I don't know why.
greetings.wnwas: I'm looking for someone. Have you seen a black-haired man with a scar?

lines.text: Cloud stands in the arena's shadow. He does not look at the crowd.
Cloud tests his blade's edge. 'I'm not a hero. I'm just here.'
Cloud watches the sunset. 'Tifa... Aerith...'
Cloud stares at the castle. 'Sephiroth was here. I know it.'
Cloud shakes his head. 'This isn't my world. Why am I still here?'

general_lines: He fights like a man chasing his own shadow.
His name is not Sephiroth. He forgets that sometimes.

npcs.name: Auron
npcs.appearance: one-armed black coat, shoulder-length black hair, flask in hand

greetings.olympus: A black coat and a flask. I've been dead for ten years. It's not as boring as it sounds.

lines.text: Auron takes a long drink. 'Hades is cheating again. I've seen this before.'
Auron watches the dead march. 'They deserve better than this.'
Auron nods to Zero. 'You have the same look I had once. Keep moving.'

general_lines: He is a ghost who refused to be silent.
The dead tell him things. He listens.

npcs.name: Axel
npcs.appearance: spiky blond hair, red Nobody coat, chakrams at his hips, lazy grin

greetings.twilight_town: Hey, didn't see you there. Name's Axel. Don't ask about the coat.
greetings.wnwas: If you see Roxas, tell him... never mind.

lines.text: Axel eats ice cream on the roof. 'Best flavor in the universe. Don't argue.'
Axel stares at the empty street. 'There was someone here. Someone like me.'
Axel flips a chakram idly. 'The Organization doesn't own the night.'
Axel looks at the stars. 'Roxas... Xion... you idiots.'

general_lines: He laughs because silence is worse.
The Organization XIII coat fits him like a wound.

npcs.name: Riku
npcs.appearance: white hair, yellow eyes, dark coat, soul-eater at his hip

greetings.destiny_islands: You know Sora. That makes you... something. Be careful.
greetings.hollow_bastion: I walked through the door once. I came out different.
greetings.twilight_town: I'm not the boy who left the islands. I'm not the man who came back either.

lines.text: Riku stands where the waves broke. 'This is where it started.'
Riku draws Soul Eater. 'Darkness isn't evil. It's just... dark.'
Riku watches the tide. 'Sora would've closed this by now. I'll do it.'

general_lines: He walks the dark road back to the light. Some days it's shorter than others.
He doesn't trust Zero. That's healthy.

npcs.name: Kairi
npcs.appearance: red hair, white dress, pink hoodie over it, gentle eyes

greetings.destiny_islands: I drew a keyblade once. Did you know?
greetings.traverse_town: I can feel the light in every world. Yours is... different.
greetings.hollow_bastion: The castle is holding something that shouldn't be held.

lines.text: Kairi draws in the sand. 'I'm not sure what I'm drawing. But it matters.'
Kairi offers Zero a paopu fruit. 'Friends share. That's how it works.'
Kairi looks at the sea. 'The door remembers me. I don't know why.'

general_lines: She is a princess of heart who chose to be a girl instead.
She calls Zero by his name. That is rarer than he thinks.

npcs.name: Xemnas
npcs.appearance: white hair, amber eyes, black coat, nothingness at his shoulders

greetings.wnwas: Ah, the liminal. I have been watching you. Documenting.

lines.text: Xemnas stands above the city. 'Nothing is nothing. And we are its architects.'
Xemnas watches the sunrise. 'A beautiful lie. I remember them.'
Xemnas addresses the air. 'The hearts we lost — they were never ours to keep.'
Xemnas looks at Zero. 'You are the door that was never opened. And I... I am the one who will close it.'

general_lines: He is the Superior of the In-between. He takes the title seriously.
He never raises his voice. He never needs to.

npcs.name: The Urchin
npcs.appearance: barefoot, oversized shirt, red bandana, gap-toothed grin

greetings.traverse_town: You're Zero, right? The kids say you eat shadows!

lines.text: The urchin squints at Zero. 'You got the same coat as the Nobodies!'
The urchin sells a potion. 'For the big scary doors.'
The urchin points at the sky. 'There's a new door! I heard it wobble!'
The urchin yawns. 'Night, Zero. Don't let the dark bite.'

general_lines: She calls everyone Zero. The real Zero doesn't mind.
She knows every door in Traverse Town. Every single one.

npcs.name: Yen Sid
npcs.appearance: long white beard, tall hat, starry robes, steady gaze

greetings.hub: Zero. The worlds speak your name, even if they do not know they speak it.
greetings.traverse_town: The keyholes are echoes. The doors are real. You understand the difference.

lines.text: Yen Sid reads an ancient tome. 'The Master of the Last Forge... yes. I remember.'
Yen Sid adjusts his spectacles. 'Drive forms are a crutch. Use them anyway.'
Yen Sid gestures at the grid. 'Seal the doors. The Archon grows stronger.'
Yen Sid looks at Zero. 'You are not a Nobody. You are not a Heartless. Do not let the dark tell you otherwise.'

general_lines: He is the only one who remembers the Last Forge.
He treats Zero like a student. Zero pretends to mind.

npcs.name: Merlin
npcs.appearance: long blue robe, pointed hat, bushy beard, spectacles on a chain

greetings.traverse_town: Ah, a new student! Have you studied the arcane arts?
greetings.hundred_acre_wood: The book remembers you, you know. From before.

lines.text: Merlin sorts potions. 'Cura for the hurt, Elixir for the lost.'
Merlin adjusts his hat. 'The Command Deck is magic, you know. Don't let Donald tell you otherwise.'
Merlin peers at Zero. 'Your keyblade hums in two voices. Keep them both.'

general_lines: He is the only wizard in three worlds who can fix a broken keyblade.
He talks too much. His students learn to listen.
